name: H02_snakeskin_veil_in_response_makes_the_opponents_spell_fizzle
note: Snakeskin Veil is an instant. The opponent casts Stab (-2/-2 until end of turn) on P0's 2/2 Bear and holds priority; P0 responds with the Veil. It resolves first: the counter makes the Bear 3/3 and it gains hexproof, so Stab's target is illegal when Stab resolves and it does nothing. Without hexproof the Bear would be 3/3 -2/-2 = 1/1, so the Bear showing 3/3 means Stab did not resolve.
